Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International. vegan. Non GMO. Certified by NSF. Certified Non-GMO. The original complete protein. Take also unto thee wheat and barley and beans and lentils and millet and spelt and put them in one vessel and make bread of it - Ezekiel 4:9. the live grain difference! See back panel for details. Our Ezekiel 4.9 Sprouted Grain English Muffins are inspired by the Holy Scripture verse: Take also unto thee Wheat, and Barley, and Beans, and Lentils, and Millet and Spelt, and put them in one vessel and make bread of it. Ez 4:9. We discovered when these six grains and legumes are sprouted and combined, an amazing thing happens. A complete protein is created that closely parallels the protein found in milk and eggs. In fact, the protein quality is so high, that it is 84.3% as efficient as the highest recognized source of protein, containing all 9 essential amino acids. There are 18 amino acids present in these unique English muffins - from all vegetable sources - naturally balanced in nature. The Live Grain Difference! Different from most English muffins today, these unique muffins are made from freshly sprouted live grains and contain absolutely no flour. We believe in sprouting the grains we use in our English muffins because sprouting is the best way to release all of the vital nutrients stored in whole grains. To unlock this dormant food energy, maximize nutrition and flavor, we add just the right amount of water to healthy whole organically grown grains which are already bursting with nutri-ents. Beneficial enzymes are activated which cause the grains to sprout and become a living food. Our exclusive sprouting process not only significantly increases vitamins but also causes a natural change that allows the protein and carbohydrates to be assimilated by the body more efficiently. And even better still, our exclusive baking process preserves these valuable nutrients and retains the important natural fiber and bran. You can see. taste. and smell the live grain difference, of Food For Life English muffins. As nutritious as they are delicious. Food For Life sprouted grain English muffins are the substance of a meal - not just something that holds a sandwich together. See the difference fresh sprouts really make. Your body and taste buds will know the difference! With just one bite. you'll know they're a food for life! Question: Are Food For Life sprouted whole grain English muffins gluten-free? Answer: While sprouting promotes the digesti-bility of grains through enzymatic activity, this product contains naturally occurring gluten found in wholegrains, such as wheat. sections.bodyString: Magic Pop is: Low in calories! Low in fat! Perfect right out of the bag, topped with sweet and savory spreads or paired with soups, salads, cheese. The possibilities are endless! What's the Magic Pop Story? After years of working together in the food business in South Korea, married couple and business partner Mr. and Mrs. Kim decided it was high time for everyone to enjoy the crisp and tasty goodness of freshly-popped Korean snack cakes. But how? The machines that make these delicacies were the size of a refrigerator! Mr. Kim applied his business and engineering knowledge to the task. The result? Table top Magic Pop machines that turn out fresh grain snack cakes right in your local super- market. sections.bodyString:
What's the Magic Pop Story? In Korea where rice is abundant, people traditionally have made rice treats. Every time a rice treat popped out of the machine, the machine would make a bang and gather a crowd. This sweet treat was loved by everyone, both men and women, the young and the old. Although the machine made delicious treats, due to its weight and size, which was analogous to that of a cannon, rice treats were only made on special occasions or in designated areas. One day, the founders of Delice Global, Mr. and Mrs. Kim contemplated how to simplify the way to make such crispy and fresh rice treats so that people could enjoy them every day. Thus, Mr. and Mrs. Kim thought of various methods using their engineering knowledge and ideas. At the end of many discussions and trials, they invented a machine that created the same delicious rice treats, but was so small and convenient that it could be placed on top of a table. Magically, that small machine still created the same bang to make a fat free, low calorie, sugar free healthy treat. Kim's Magic Pop is a union of a traditional Korean treat and modern technology.

Ambrosi Mozzarella di Bufala Campana D.O.P. is a masterpiece of Italian cheesemaking, representing the rich culinary heritage of the Campania region. Crafted from the milk of water buffalo, this artisanal cheese is celebrated for its creamy texture and delicate, lactic flavor. Its porcelain white appearance reflects its freshness, while its stretchable body showcases the traditional pasta filata technique, ensuring a delightful experience in every bite.

A Note on Versatility: The mild yet rich flavor of Ambrosi Mozzarella di Bufala Campana makes it a versatile ingredient in various dishes. Whether you're topping a classic Margherita pizza, creating a vibrant caprese salad, or indulging in a creamy pasta dish, this mozzarella elevates every meal. Its ability to melt beautifully enhances both baked and fresh preparations, making it a staple in Italian cuisine.

Serving Suggestions: Packaged in a vacuum-sealed flow pack film, Ambrosi Mozzarella di Bufala Campana is designed to maintain optimal freshness and quality. Perfect for enjoying on its own, it can also be sliced and paired with fresh basil and tomatoes for a refreshing appetizer. For a unique twist, try it grilled or melted over vegetables or as part of a charcuterie board, accompanied by cured meats and olives for a delightful combination.

sections.bodyString: Quality with integrity. Ideal for baking & cooking. No greasing needed. Completely non-stick. No toxic additives. Won't affect taste of food. Healthy home. Healthy planet. Healthy you. Those are big promises, but you can't have one without the others, so here's our thinking. We are all intimately connected within our world. Choices we make affect us all, even the choice of paper you use in baking. If you care about your choices, so do we. And when we care, we all benefit. Chlorine. If You Care parchment paper is made specifically from unbleached, totally chlorine free (TCF) paper. Removing chlorine eliminates the risk of its residues and derivatives from entering lakes, rivers or streams where it can have harmful long-term effects on our ecosystem. Nobody needs bleached paper to bake with, but we all need clean water. Paper. We use Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) paper for our base materials. Worldwide, illegal logging accounts for millions of acres of forest loss and untold damage. FSC certification ensures our paper comes from sources that promote the most rigorous environmental and social standards of stewardship in forestry. We think this is a good thing and worth supporting, even for your baking. Non-Stick. To make your baking less stressful and a pleasure, our non-stick surface is made with a form of silicon, easily found on earth, that is non-toxic and easily composted. Not to be confused with other silicone coatings that are not compostable. And that's because we think your baking should be free from residues and toxins, so it's simply easy, reliable and fun. and composting is a big part of this product's lifecycle too. Lifecycle. You might think all papers are compostable, but that's not true. Paper comes in many forms from various processes. Our paper is certified compostable at home and in municipal facilities, and this is important because globally, millions of tons of valuable biobased materials go to landfill, where they are rendered useless, or worse, produce methane, a destructive greenhouse gas that accelerates climate change. Composting. Composting at home or in municipal facilities means returning material to our ecosystem. The micro fauna also get a good meal and produce fantastic, soil-enriching, life-giving compost that locks up carbon, and contributes to soil health, ready for the next generation of life. It all adds up to our circle of life moment. Lovely thought. FSC & Compostable certified unbleached totally chlorine-free (TCF). USDA Certified Biobased Product: Product 100%. FSC: Mix - Paper from responsible sources. Product Lifecycle: Choosing Our Materials: Parchment paper from FSC certified forest. Unbleached totally chlorine free (TCF). Silicone coating derived from silicon in sand/quartz/rock. Cardboard box is recycled processed chlorine free (PCF). Supporting Our World: FSC certified paper from well managed forests. 100% certified compostable. Totally chlorine free (TCF). Silicone, derived from silicon, abundant in nature, non-toxic. Caring for Your Home: Excellent for baking and cooking. No greasing necessary. Microwave safe; oven safe to 428 degrees F / 220 degrees C. Parchment paper is reusable. Completing the Cycle: Recycle the cardboard box. Compost parchment paper in municipal or commercial compost facilities where available, and can also be home composted. TUV Austria: Ok compost - Industrial: If You Care Certified compostable parchment baking paper is compostable in commercial composting facilities and meet the standards of EN 13432. Appropriate facilities may not exist in your area. sections.bodyString: The original. Wow no cow! The cold, hard world of customer feedback. Stick to oatmilk. We get it often. Why don't you just shut up about what you think and focus on your own products. Well, if your only reason for being is to make money for your shareholders, then that is a generic and safe strategy, but it is certainly not ours. If you want to build a better society for people and work to ensure the planet we live on continues to live past our limited time here, then it makes perfect sense to share what we think is important, like treating people equally and fairly, producing food that is nutritional and sustainable, and opting for plants over animals as a source of nourishment. If that's not something you are into, that's okay. Freedom is such a wonderful thing. It's the official international Oatly anthem!
